name: Preparation of a Standard Solution
teachingNotes: A standard solution requires quantitative transfer of accurately weighed primary standard into a calibrated volumetric flask, dissolved and brought to the meniscus calibration mark at 20°C.

steps.prompt: Step 1: Weigh solid. Place weighing boat on the balance, press 'Tare / Zero', then add solid using the spatula.
steps.hint: Tare the balance with the boat on the pan first. The digital mass display shows an illustrative value (e.g. 2.1200 g).
steps.completionText: Analytical balance tared and illustrative solid mass recorded: 2.1200 g ± 0.0001 g.

steps.prompt: Step 2: Dissolve in beaker. Transfer solid into a beaker, add ~30 mL distilled water, and stir with glass rod.
steps.hint: Always dissolve solids in a beaker first! Never pour dry solid powder directly into a narrow volumetric flask neck.
steps.completionText: Solid completely dissolved in beaker with distilled water; solution is clear and uniform.

steps.prompt: Step 3: Quantitative transfer. Insert funnel into volumetric flask, pour solution along glass rod, and rinse.
steps.hint: Rinse beaker, glass rod, and funnel 3 times with wash bottle to ensure zero analyte is left behind.
steps.completionText: Solution quantitatively transferred into volumetric flask along stirring rod; rinsings collected.

steps.prompt: Step 4: Dilute near mark. Add distilled water from wash bottle until liquid is ~1 cm below the calibration line.
steps.hint: Stop bulk addition below the etched line to avoid accidentally overshooting the calibrated volume.
steps.completionText: Volumetric flask filled with solvent to approximately 1 cm below neck calibration line.

steps.prompt: Step 5: Meniscus mini-game! Click the Dropper to add final drops until bottom of meniscus touches mark.
steps.hint: Align eye level horizontally with the calibration line. Deliver drop-by-drop until bottom of meniscus aligns exactly.
steps.completionText: Calibration mark reached! Curved liquid meniscus rests precisely on the ring mark at eye level.

steps.prompt: Step 6: Invert to mix. Insert ground-glass stopper and invert flask repeatedly to achieve uniform concentration.
steps.hint: Hold stopper firmly with thumb and index finger, then invert the flask 10 times to ensure thorough homogeneity.
steps.completionText: Standard solution inverted and thoroughly homogenized. Prepared solution is ready for analysis!

direct_flask_pour.message: Technique error: Never pour dry solid directly into a volumetric flask! Solid cakes in the narrow neck and resists dissolving. Always dissolve in a beaker first.

overshoot_mark.message: Irreversible error: Meniscus rose above the etched calibration mark! The solution is over-diluted and concentration is ruined. In real practice you must discard and re-weigh.

untared_balance.message: Measurement error: Solid was added to the weighing boat without pressing Tare, introducing the mass of the plastic boat into the reading.
